title: incident-bot: attach SLO context + runbook linking for on-call summaries
author: Aisha Patel
description: Add SLO context enrichment and runbook linking to incident-bot on-call summaries. Motivation: on-call responders need immediate access to the most relevant SLOs and runbooks when a page fires; attaching these programmatically reduces mean time to acknowledge and improves consistent next steps. This PR adds two capabilities: 1) slo-toolkit helper integration: incident-bot calls the new SLO lookup API to fetch SLO metadata (name, objective, current burn, owners, and canonical runbook links) for the alerted service. 2) runbook linking and recommendation heuristics: incident-bot will attach high-confidence runbook links and optionally recommend a secondary runbook using a simple similarity heuristic (service tags + alert title). The change includes backfilling runbook links in the on-call summary card UI, a compact runbook quick-link list in Slack/Teams messages, and a new admin toggle to enable/disable automatic runbook suggestions. Checklist: - [x] add slo-toolkit client wrapper and cached fetch endpoint - [x] implement runbook linking pipeline + heuristics - [x] add admin toggle and feature flag - [x] update on-call summary templates (Slack/Teams/email) - [x] add unit and integration tests for fetch/caching/templating - [x] add docs (README + admin console docs) - [x] smoke test in staging and dry-run rollout on a single team Related: ENG-6742 (slo lookup), OPS-243 (oncall workflow improvements). Notes: the implementation is opt-in via admin flag and defaults to dry-run for 48h after rollout. Performance: cached SLO lookups use TTL=5m and background refresh to avoid adding latency to page handling. Security: runbook links are validated against allowed-runbook domains; we added an allowlist to the admin console.
